paragraphs.text: Carbonate reservoirs are not always homogeneous. The porosity is approximately 18.5% and the permeability reaches 120 mD [1]. We propose a new method for CO2 flooding.
The loss function is L = - Σ p log(q) (1). Only three basins were studied, and no significant difference was observed.
Figure 1. Workflow of carbonate facies classification using CNN.
Carbonate reservoirs in three basins were analyzed. The model achieved high accuracy.
